us-sales-office.intro: HMC supports China-based medical technology companies planning US sales operations, including sales processes and market information. The engagement is commercial support; product-specific regulatory submissions are scoped separately.
us-sales-office.work: US sales operations and market information

clinical-study.intro: HMC supports medical device and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) companies with clinical performance study planning, operations and analysis for product-specific FDA or European submission requirements.
clinical-study.work: Clinical performance study planning, management and analysis
clinical-study.framework: Product-specific FDA or European submission requirements

otc-drug.intro: HMC supports over-the-counter (OTC) drug companies with FDA establishment registration, product listing and submission documentation, including structured product labeling (SPL). The applicable requirements depend on the product.
otc-drug.work: Registration, product listing and labeling documentation
otc-drug.framework: Applicable FDA drug registration and submission requirements

product-development.intro: HMC supports medical technology companies with product development planning and evidence requirements for the intended market. Regulatory preparation is scoped to the product and its proposed submission route.
product-development.work: Product development planning and evidence requirements

regulatory-strategy.intro: HMC helps medical device companies assess FDA submission options, including 510(k), investigational device exemption (IDE) and other product-specific routes. Review includes intended use, technology and the availability of a predicate device.
regulatory-strategy.work: Review of intended use, technology and possible submission routes
regulatory-strategy.framework: 510(k), IDE and other product-specific FDA routes

regulatory-submission.intro: HMC supports medical technology companies preparing FDA and European submission materials. Scope may include 510(k), Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) or In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation (IVDR) documentation, according to the product and applicable pathway.
regulatory-submission.work: Preparation and coordination of submission materials
regulatory-submission.framework: 510(k), EUA or European IVDR, as applicable

post-market-surveillance.intro: HMC supports medical device companies with post-market surveillance plans and risk-management work under applicable US and European requirements. Activities are scoped to the product, market and existing quality management system.
post-market-surveillance.work: Post-market surveillance planning and risk-management review
post-market-surveillance.framework: Applicable US and European post-market requirements

facility-registration-listing.intro: HMC supports medical device and IVD establishments with FDA establishment registration and device listing. These administrative requirements are distinct from product-specific premarket clearance or approval.
facility-registration-listing.work: FDA establishment registration and device listing

fda-us-agent.intro: HMC offers FDA US agent support for foreign establishments and assistance with registration-related communication. The applicable appointment and registration requirements depend on the establishment and product category.
fda-us-agent.work: US agent support and registration communication

food-dietary-supplements.intro: HMC supports food and dietary supplement businesses with FDA facility registration, labeling review and applicable import requirements, including Foreign Supplier Verification Programs (FSVP). Scope depends on the product and business role.
food-dietary-supplements.work: Registration, labeling review and import-requirement support
food-dietary-supplements.framework: Applicable FDA food requirements and FSVP

cgmp.intro: HMC supports manufacturers with current good manufacturing practice (CGMP) audits and quality-system review. For medical devices, FDA requirements include the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR) in 21 CFR Part 820.
cgmp.work: CGMP audits, quality-system review and product traceability
cgmp.framework: Product-specific CGMP; device QMSR in 21 CFR Part 820

medical-device-510k.intro: HMC supports medical device companies preparing FDA 510(k) premarket notifications and related regulatory documentation. The submission route and evidence requirements depend on the device and its intended use.

eua-application.intro: HMC supports developers preparing Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) materials for medical products. Eligibility, submission scope and authorization depend on the applicable FDA emergency framework.

marketing.intro: HMC supports medical device businesses with market information, branding and distributor outreach for US market entry. Product claims and promotional scope require product-specific review.
marketing.work: Market information, branding and distributor outreach
marketing.framework: US market entry and product-specific promotional requirements

project-management.intro: HMC supports clinical study sponsors with study plans, coordination and progress reporting. Project responsibilities and documentation are aligned with the study protocol and applicable good clinical practice (GCP) requirements.
project-management.work: Study plans, coordination and progress reporting
project-management.framework: Study protocol and applicable GCP requirements

clinical-operations.intro: HMC supports clinical study sponsors with site start-up, monitoring and study-document coordination under applicable good clinical practice (GCP) requirements. Work includes trial master file (TMF) and informed consent form (ICF) documentation where specified.
clinical-operations.work: Site start-up, monitoring and study-document coordination
clinical-operations.framework: Study protocol and applicable GCP requirements

data-management.intro: HMC supports clinical study sponsors with data management plans, case report forms (CRFs), data review and database-lock preparation. Work follows the study protocol and applicable data standards.
data-management.work: Data management plans, CRFs, data review and database-lock preparation
data-management.framework: Study protocol and applicable data standards

biostatistics.intro: HMC supports study teams with sample-size planning, statistical analysis plans and reporting. For diagnostic studies, analysis may address sensitivity and specificity against the study protocol and intended submission requirements.
biostatistics.work: Sample-size planning, statistical analysis plans and reporting
biostatistics.framework: Study protocol and intended submission requirements

quality-assurance.intro: HMC supports clinical study teams with process assessments, audit planning and documentation of findings. The review scope follows the study requirements and applicable good clinical practice (GCP) standards.
quality-assurance.work: Process assessments, audit planning and documented findings
quality-assurance.framework: Study requirements and applicable GCP standards

fda-regulatory-consulting.intro: HMC supports medical product companies with FDA development planning and submission preparation. Services are scoped to the product and applicable pathway, including 510(k), De Novo, premarket approval (PMA) or Emergency Use Authorization (EUA).
fda-regulatory-consulting.work: FDA development planning and submission preparation
fda-regulatory-consulting.framework: 510(k), De Novo, PMA or EUA, as applicable

ivdr.intro: HMC supports in vitro diagnostic manufacturers with technical documentation and quality-system planning under the European In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Regulation (IVDR). The work supports applicable conformity assessment and CE marking preparation.
ivdr.framework: European IVDR conformity assessment and CE marking preparation

market-research.intro: HMC supports medical technology companies reviewing target markets and commercialization requirements. Research scope is defined around the product category, market and regulatory questions that need investigation.

post-market-compliance.intro: HMC supports life science companies responding to FDA inspection observations and warning letters. Work includes corrective-action planning and documentation review for the applicable product and quality requirements.
post-market-compliance.framework: Applicable FDA inspection and quality requirements

preclinical-research.intro: HMC supports developers with preclinical study planning and laboratory selection for product-specific FDA evaluation requirements. Study scope and laboratory responsibilities are confirmed for each engagement.
preclinical-research.work: Preclinical study planning and laboratory selection

clinical-investigation.intro: HMC supports pharmaceutical sponsors with clinical trial planning, management and analysis for regulatory submissions. The study scope is defined by the development program, protocol and applicable clinical investigation requirements.
clinical-investigation.work: Clinical trial planning, management and analysis
clinical-investigation.framework: Development program and applicable clinical investigation requirements

quality-system.intro: HMC supports medical device companies with quality management system documentation under FDA QMSR, 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485, as applicable. Scope includes assessment, action planning and supporting records.
quality-system.work: Quality-system documentation, assessment and action planning
quality-system.framework: FDA QMSR, 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485, as applicable

laboratory-services.intro: HMC coordinates laboratory support for diagnostic projects through associated businesses and partners. The laboratory provider, validation scope and applicable quality requirements are confirmed for each engagement.
laboratory-services.work: Coordination of laboratory providers and validation scope
